title: POV: You Wake Up in Hattusa — Capital of the Hittite Empire #shorts
hook_text: THIS BRONZE AGE CAPITAL CONTROLLED AN EMPIRE
description:
Step into Hattusa, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.

#history #archaeology #lostworlds #ancienthistory #shorts
